Our midweek Green Deals edition is being led by Lectric’s newest 46-pound Xpress Lite e-bike that just launched at $1,099 , which coincides with the bundle for $336 in FREE gear on the XPress2 Cruiser/Commuter e-bikes at $1,299 continuing over from the Better-Than-Prime sale. Right behind that we have two options for EcoFlow’s 572Wh RIVER 3 Max Expanded Power Station at a new $303 low or getting a FREE $40 tool pegboard at Amazon for $319. From there, we have two cordless electric snow blower deals on EGO’s 21-inch model with 2x 6.0Ah batteries at an $899 annual low , or the 80V Greenworks 20-inch model at a new $450 low . There’s also Worx’s newest 40V 3-in-1 Trivac Cordless Leaf Blower/Vacuum/Mulcher with either 2x or 4x battery bundles starting from $260 , as well as more deals to get you through fall and winter below. You’ll also find the hangover deals from the last two days at the bottom of the page, like the yesterday’s EcoFlow TITAN series whole-home backup system early-bird deposit deals or the brand’s latest flash sale lineup ending tonight, and more.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Hop on Lectric’s new 46-pound XPress Lite e-bike for $1,099 or the XPress2 models with $336 FREE bundles at $1,299
Despite its previous sale from last week having officially ended, Lectric is continuing many of the bundle deals we saw during that event, like the long-range XPress2 Cruiser/Commuter e-bikes with a FREE bundle of $336 gear at $1,299 shipped . What’s even bigger, though, is the brand’s launch of the XPress Lite Lightweight City e-bike at $1,099 shipped , which comes as a slimmed down and more manageable model for urban dwellers/commuters. While this new model isn’t getting any included bundled gear during this preorder launch period (shipping expected around November 2), its counterpart is holding onto the package from last week’s event that gives you a rear cargo rack, fender set, suspension seat post, and Elite headlight.
You can learn about both these e-bike’s features in our original coverage here .
Advertisement - scroll for more content
EcoFlow’s expanded 572Wh RIVER 3 Max power station setup gets extra savings to a new $303 low
As part of the ongoing EcoFlow Prime Encore Sale , you can currently get the best price to date on the RIVER 3 Max Portable Power Station bundle (RIVER 3 Plus + Extra Battery 300) down at $303.05 shipped , after using the code EFPDFAFF at checkout, beating out Amazon’s pricing by $16 , but you do get a FREE $40 tool pegboard with a purchase there. Down from a $399 full price, we’ve been seeing it consistently discounted to $319 since the beginning of June, which happens to be the lowest price spotted at marketplaces like Amazon. With the bonus savings code, things are dipping lower for $96 combined savings and marking a new all-time low price. You can shop the brand’s larger power station units in the Prime Encore Sale here .
Clear up to a 14-car driveway with EGO’s 21-inch cordless snow blower + 2x 6.0Ah batteries at an $899 2026 low
Amazon is gearing up for winter’s arrival in December with a deal for the EGO Power+ 56V 21-inch Cordless Electric Snow Blower and 2x 6.0Ah batteries at $899 shipped . While it did sit a little over $1,000 earlier in the year, this model hasn’t seen very many discounts in 2026 but has been regularly going in and out of stock. That said, since mid-September it’s mostly kept down to $999, starting off last week’s Prime Day event with a fall to $900 before quickly rising back up on the second day. The deal here gives you a solid $100 markdown off the going rate, landing it at the best price we have seen this year and the second-best price historically.
Worx’s 2026 40V Trivac 3-in-1 cordless leaf blower/vacuum/mulcher with 2x or 4x batteries starting from $260
Amazon is currently offering the biggest savings yet on Worx’s newest Trivac 40V 3-in-1 600 CFM Cordless Electric Leaf Blower/Vacuum/Mulcher with 4x 20V 4.0Ah batteries down at $319.99 shipped . This model has only been on the market since September, and has only seen Prime-exclusive falls to $330 earlier in October and through Prime Day. Today’s deal gives you an even bigger $50 savings cut from the tag, landing it at a new all-time low price just in time for all your fall cleanup needs. If you don’t need that many batteries, you can also find this same Trivac model bundled with 2x batteries down at $259.99 shipped from $300, which is the second-lowest price we have tracked behind last week’s $255 low.
You can learn about this new 3-in-1 Trivac’s features in our original coverage here .
Affordably clear away winter with Greenworks’ 80V 20-inch cordless snow blower at a new $450 low (Reg. $530)
Amazon is currently offering the best price yet on a newer Greenworks 80V 20-inch Cordless Electric Snow Blower with a 4.0Ah battery down at $449.99 shipped . Down from $530, this is a 2025 model that even beats out its older predecessor with a 2.0Ah battery by $20 . It’s been in and out of stock throughout 2026, with all it’s previous deals having only cut the cost as low as $471 until now. The deal here provides you with $80 savings and marks a new all-time low price with plenty of time for winter prepping needs.
Govee’s Halloween Sale drops 200-foot Matter Permanent Outdoor Lights 2 Pro to $600 low, more from $60 (Up to 37% off)
Save over $300 on Hisense’s M2 Pro smart projector at $997, C3 smart laser model at $1,700 low
Tackle dry fall and winter air with Govee’s 7L Smart Humidifier Max down at $70 (Reg. $130)
